title: rpl_stack/tests.rs:2962: unused mut on 'sender' in worker4's root-sig pin tests (-D warnings gate)
description: Pre-existing compiler warning in freshly-landed dyqf pin tests (worker4, 099bede110): rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:2962 'let mut sender = RplStack::provision_root(...)' — rustc warns 'variable does not need to be mutable'. Surfaces under cargo check --all-targets; will trip any -D warnings clippy gate on the lib-test target. Fix: drop the mut (or confirm a later &mut use exists and the warning is stale). Spotted during u00k verification; not fixed there to stay surgical.
